Award-Session browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type simulation amp simulation browse by type simulation speaker/cabinet simulation browse by enclosure pedal Award-Session JD10 MkII Direct Recording Guitar Amp Emulator Published on September 25, 2016 Award-Session amp simulation distortion speaker/cabinet simulation pedal Information The Award-Session JD10 is a multi-purpose pedal. It can be an overdrive, distortion, preamp (with switchable speaker emulation for direct recording or live performance through a PA), EQ, line driver etc...  This, the very rare Mark 2 version, builds on the original with updated circuitry plus some extra features. As well as the usual input and output, there is also a 'Tuner Output' (this is an always active, buffered direct output so can also be used for signal splitting) and an XLR output which duplicates the main output.
